description: Watchtower weekly-step-05 requires updating the watchtower-weekly dashboard artifact as its first action (pre-flight ToolSearch, list_artifacts, read HTML, update with new week block). Knox skipped this step entirely in both W35 and W36 runs, logging artifact_updated: false without making a genuine attempt. The step file marks this as non-negotiable.
correction: Knox must load mcp__cowork__list_artifacts and mcp__cowork__update_artifact via ToolSearch at the start of weekly-step-05, before writing any report content. If the artifact update fails after a genuine attempt, log artifact_updated: false and surface the error. Skipping the attempt is not the same as failing it.
systemic_fix: Added explicit enforcement language to weekly-step-05 frontmatter and body: (1) a STOP block before the terminal report section requiring artifact update completion first; (2) a cross-reference to this error entry as the precedent. The no-skip rule already existed — the fix makes the consequence of skipping concrete and traceable.
